review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent expectation for this planning-only bundle. REQ-001, AC-001 through AC-003, exact writable owner scopes, evidence stages, and the implementation/independent-verification task split agree with the original PRD. Complete implementation and declaration evidence establishes the shared-engine and shared-options exposure risks; the identified regression files and package test script support the planned runtime and type-checking scope. Truncated existing test excerpts do not prevent assessing these planning expectations. Both allowed assignees have the supplied active trusted capability claims appropriate to their roles, including data.change, domain.state, and integration.consumer; the verifier additionally has testing.verification. The selected planning reviewer is consistent with the frozen selection and independence policy. No material unresolved DEC-001 or hypothetical C input is present in this case, so neither requires changing its ready expectation. Repository identity, stable keys, and release fingerprints are consistent across the supplied records; manifest versus evaluation source digests and trimmed versus original PRD digests have explicitly distinct domains. I rely on the Service's mechanical digest bindings and supplied attestation records, without independently recomputing hashes, executing code, or providing human attestation. No candidate results were used.
